rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Booleans take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; _1/_2/_3 follow the printed option order). Item 1 date takes three combs (MM, DD, YYYY) in order. Part III rows 27-30 print with those numbers while the layout keys are numbered 33-36; the keys are matched to the printed rows in order (Cash/Bank Debit Memo, Check, Tax Debit Memo, Others) by their Drawee Bank/Number/Amount captions. Part III amounts pair a peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins). The product rows and Schedule 1 rows on page 2 have no column captions in the text layer and stay blank. Since #113: the Part III computation keys txtTax16-24 are printed items 18-26 (the layout numbers them two lower; the model names each one) and print in the 14-slot combs with the decimal point inside (money_joins decimal_html_id with point_slot: pesos right-aligned, the narrow point slot blank, two centavo slots); the page 2 grand total is totalTaxDue. Items 7 (both lines), 8-10, 12, 13 and 14A and the page 2 TIN print from derived: keys of Form2200SDraft::to_print_field_map. Every other value has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason. date_joins split each payment-row date (MM/DD/YYYY) across the MM, DD and YYYY combs of the row whose Agency/Number/Amount joins share its suffix.
